text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen holds a precious memory—

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—My goodness! The Mejiro family's history 
truly is amazing, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think that Grandfather and Grandmother 
built this Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, one day, I too shall support the 
Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I'll even win the 'Tenno Sho' 
for you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Grandmother," the pillar of the Mejiro 
family, gave a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm getting out of breath 
less easily than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, Trainer, how was 
it?
choice_data_list: You've really built up your stamina.
You've really built up your stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so too? What a 
relief...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This is entirely thanks to your patient 
guidance and support, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"We must maintain this condition all the 
way to the Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, I decided to walk Mejiro 
McQueen back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And along the way—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, McQueen spotted!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Gold Ship— an utterly wild and 
unpredictable Umamusume. You never know 
what she's going to pull.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go, Gol-Gol Delivery Service! Take 
it, sucka!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Kyaah!? What in the world!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is this... a letter from 
Grandmother?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, that happened with Grandfather? Fufu, 
you two get along wonderfully as always.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Shall we take a walk and chat at 
our leisure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There was also a large pond in the Mejiro 
family's garden.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We used to go on walks around here all the 
time... .........
choice_data_list: It's a precious memory, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Every member of the Mejiro family is 
irreplaceable to me, and all of it is a 
precious memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Which is probably why.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural to want to win the Tenno 
Sho—a race of utmost importance to the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(The proud history of the Mejiro family, 
which led them to be hailed as 
prestigious...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Grandfather, Grandmother, and all those 
who built our history...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(I truly wish to show everyone I respect, 
no matter what.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Me... winning the Tenno Sho...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)— the goal she had 
never wavered from since her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She was steadily approaching that stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, I'm home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ryan...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're late, you barely made curfew! I was 
worried something happened to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry. I just couldn't help getting 
totally absorbed in it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...If I'm running, I want to make sure I 
deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —In the "Tenno Sho (Spring)..."
